cohort: 9 pregnant women with SARS-CoV-2 infection and 9 controls matched by maternal age, parity, and status of chronic disease
finding: Neonates of mothers with SARS-CoV-2 infection during pregnancy had lower scores in communication, gross movement, fine movement, problem-solving, and personal-social domains, with a statistically significant difference in the fine movement domain.
mod_finding: The majority of pregnant women with SARS-CoV-2 experienced cesarean section (7 out of 9), which was higher than the control group (5 out of 9).
